title: Proper/open tensor-mate interchange on varying-coefficient systems
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\ge1$. For each scheme $W$ below put $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$ on a fixed small representative of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Write $\mathscr S_W$ for the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of these module sheaves, with componentwise morphisms commuting with the quotient transitions, and use its ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\mathscr S_W)$ [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use the simultaneous system functors $P_u=u^*$, $R_u=Ru_*$ with $P_u\dashv R_u$, unit $\eta_u$, counit $\varepsilon_u$, and exact open extension $j_!$ of that node. Write $\mu_u:P_u(F\otimes^LG)\cong P_uF\otimes^LP_uG$ for the canonical tensor comparison. Let $\pi_{u;H,Q}:R_uH\otimes^LQ\to R_u(H\otimes^LP_uQ)$ be the transpose of $(\varepsilon_{u,H}\otimes1)\mu_u$, and $\delta_{j;H,Q}:j_!H\otimes^LQ\cong j_!(H\otimes^LP_jQ)$ the canonical open tensor comparison [def-exchange-projection, lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization].

Let $A,B,C,D$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $k_1:A\hookrightarrow B$ and $i:C\hookrightarrow D$ quasi-compact open immersions, and $r:A\to C$, $p_1:B\to D$ proper morphisms with $p_1k_1=ir$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $B_C=B\times_D C$, with projections $b:B_C\to B$, $q:B_C\to C$, and $s=(k_1,r):A\to B_C$. Use the clopen immersion and component projection $\rho_s:F\to s_!s^*F$ of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], which is identity on $s(A)$ and zero on its complementary component. On the varying-ring diagram sites define $a:P_{p_1}i_!\to k_{1!}P_r$ by open base change $P_{p_1}i_!\cong b_!P_q$, then $b_!\rho_sP_q$ and $b_!s_!\cong k_{1!}$. Set
$$\gamma=R_{p_1}(k_{1!}\varepsilon_r)\,R_{p_1}(aR_r)\,\eta_{p_1}i_!R_r:i_!R_r\longrightarrow R_{p_1}k_{1!}.$$
For arbitrary $H\in D(\mathscr S_A)$ and $Q\in D(\mathscr S_D)$ one has
$$\gamma_{H\otimes^LP_rP_iQ}\,i_!(\pi_{r;H,P_iQ})\,\delta_{i;R_rH,Q}
=R_{p_1}(\delta_{k_1;H,P_{p_1}Q})\,\pi_{p_1;k_{1!}H,Q}\,(\gamma_H\otimes1_Q).$$
This equality has source $i_!R_rH\otimes^LQ$ and target $R_{p_1}k_{1!}(H\otimes^LP_rP_iQ)$, using $P_{k_1}P_{p_1}\cong P_rP_i$. It is an equality in $D(\mathscr S_D)$ before evaluation or inverse limit. No invertibility of $\gamma$ or $\pi$ is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-system-clopen-alpha-tensor-square] to G=R_r H and Q. This is the alpha/tensor identity before either proper adjunction is transposed, with the canonical square P_k P_p → P_r P_i on the right.

Prove naturality in the first argument of delta directly from its inverse open-unit transpose. Apply the open Hom bijection, use naturality of mu inverse and of the open adjunction unit, and cancel the inverse delta maps. This is the private Lean helper delta_naturality_left.

Apply injectivity of the inverse P_p ⊣ R_p Hom bijection. The counit identities for projection and gamma give the transposes. On the left, alpha naturality at pi_r and the projection counit equation reduce to P_p(delta_i), alpha, k_!(mu_r), k_!(epsilon_r tensor identity). On the right, counit naturality moves out R_p(delta_k and the square); mu_p naturality and the mate counit equation replace P_p(gamma) followed by epsilon_p by alpha followed by k_!epsilon_r. Use the first step and delta naturality, then bifunctoriality to commute the first-variable counit with the second-variable square comparison. The transposes agree. Neither gamma nor either projection is inverted. This formal calculation is proved as the private, category-generic helper mate_tensor_interchange and specialized to the supplied system functors, keeping the large geometric definitions folded.

lean.statement: theorem system_clopen_tensor_compatibility (K : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ K.p) (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (o : TensorOperations l E) {A B C F : Scheme.{u}} [A.Over (Spec (.of K.k))] [B.Over (Spec (.of K.k))] [C.Over (Spec (.of K.k))] [F.Over (Spec (.of K.k))] [IsSeparated (A ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [QuasiCompact (A ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [IsSeparated (B ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [QuasiCompact (B ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [IsSeparated (C ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [IsSeparated (F ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (F ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] [QuasiCompact (F ↘ Spec (.of K.k))] (k : A ⟶ B) (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B ⟶ F) (i : C ⟶ F) [k.IsOver (Spec (.of K.k))] [r.IsOver (Spec (.of K.k))] [p.IsOver (Spec (.of K.k))] [i.IsOver (Spec (.of K.k))] [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (H : D l E A) (Q : D l E F) : (o.delta i ((pushDerived l E r).obj H) Q).hom ≫ (o.J i).map (o.projection r H ((o.P i).obj Q)) ≫ (o.gamma k r p i h).app ((o.T A).obj (H, (o.P r).obj ((o.P i).obj Q))) = (o.T F).map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom ((o.gamma k r p i h).app H) (𝟙 Q)) ≫ o.projection p ((o.J k).obj H) Q ≫ (pushDerived l E p).map ((o.delta k H ((o.P p).obj Q)).hom ≫ (o.J k).map ((o.T A).map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom (𝟙 H) ((o.square k r p i h).hom.app Q))))
